description: Scan a local repo directory for auto-exec hooks: npm install scripts, Claude Code settings hooks, VS Code folderOpen tasks, husky, lefthook, pre-commit, Cursor and Codex configs, MCP autostart configs, and GitHub workflow run steps. Classifies each hook SAFE, RISKY, or UNKNOWN and returns a CLEAN, REVIEW, or COMPROMISED-PATTERN verdict with evidence per finding. Deterministic, local only, no network.
name: scan_hooks
